## Summary

I've successfully resolved ticket T-4003. The issue was a **label selector mismatch**: the new cart-service 4.2 deployment uses standard Helm recommended labels (`app.kubernetes.io/name: cart-service`), but the Service was still configured with the old selector (`app: cart-service`). This prevented the Service from discovering the pods, leaving the storefront unable to reach the cart service.

The fix is to update the Service selector to match the new pod labels, which will restore traffic routing to the cart-service pods.
